Other acquisitions.

Yeah.

Yeah.
All right.

Yeah.

Just.

Yeah, perfect.

To meet her.

Okay, cool.

Yeah.
Okay.

Need those numbers for next year.
Just to make sure that it's going to be something.

Yeah, exactly.
Yeah.

Okay.
All right.

Thanks.

- Target acquisition completion timeline is realistically estimated at 3 to 6 months, influenced by the holiday season and current workload.

- Andrew Schofield views Pro Sales as a project-based service with high client retention potential, envisioning transformation into a profit center for Finelight.

The acquisition aligns strategically with the buyer's ambitions, particularly in enhancing event management capabilities.
